Container.Name: Disc-o-Matic
Container.Overview: Disc-o-Matic: a disc-ripping appliance with a web UI. Insert a disc and it is read and recognised: Blu-ray, UHD, DVD and HD DVD are backed up whole or ripped to MKV with MakeMKV (movies, TV season discs, concerts; Plex/Jellyfin naming); audio CDs are read with cdparanoia, checked against AccurateRip and CTDB, tagged from MusicBrainz and saved as FLAC, MP3 or Opus with cover art; data discs are copied as ISO images. Optional automatic jobs with a countdown, live progress, history with logs. Nothing is overwritten without asking.
Container.License: Free to use; source not published. The templates and docs in its repository: MIT. Bundles MakeMKV under its own EULA.
Container.Requires: An optical drive passed through as two devices: /dev/sr0 and its SCSI generic device /dev/sgN (find N with: for d in /sys/class/scsi_generic/*; do [ "$(cat $d/device/type)" = 5 ] && echo /dev/${d##*/}; done). UHD discs need a drive MakeMKV can use in LibreDrive mode. Bundles MakeMKV: see its EULA.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web UI, REST API and live updates: the port on the server (the app listens on 8088 inside the container).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database (dom.db), job logs, MakeMKV settings and downloaded data. Optional dom.yaml for settings.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Default home of all output: Bluray/ and DVD/ (full backups), MKV/, TV/, Concerts/, Music/ (CDs), CD Images/, ISO/ (data discs). Each can be moved elsewhere in Settings → Storage (map that folder here first, e.g. /mnt/user/Music → /music). Use a /mnt/user/... path: the mover leaves it alone (a /mnt/cache/... folder is moved away by the mover).

Config.Name: Optical drive
Config.Description: Block device of the optical drive.

Config.Name: Optical drive (SCSI generic)
Config.Description: SCSI generic device of the same drive (MakeMKV talks to the drive through it). The number can change when disks are added; see Requires for how to find it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users). The drive's own groups are added automatically.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions of new backups and rips: 000 (rw for everyone, Unraid's own convention) lets SMB users rename and delete them; 002 keeps them from others; 022 read-only for all but the app.
